description: Figure 7(b) presents a donut chart illustrating the distribution of different task types within conversations involving Agency A, as part of a study on verified Wildchat journalist-LLM interactions. The chart is labeled "Task Type" and is segmented into three distinct categories, each represented by a different color. The largest segment, colored red, represents "Article generation," which accounts for 83.2% of the tasks. The second largest segment, colored yellow, corresponds to "Headline generation," making up 16.8% of the tasks. The smallest segment, colored blue, represents "Article editing," which constitutes 4.1% of the total. The percentages are explicitly labeled next to each corresponding segment. The chart is part of a trio, with this being the middle figure, and is captioned as "(b) Agency A" and "The distribution of different task types across turns from verified Wildchat journalist-LLM conversations."
